literal: Because right conduct gives excellence, right conduct must be cherished even more than life.
translation: Since right conduct brings excellence, it should be guarded even more preciously than life itself.
modern: ஒழுக்கம் சிறப்பைத் தருவதால், அந்த ஒழுக்கத்தை உயிரை விட மேலானதாகக் கருதிப் பாதுகாக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet establishes the supreme importance of right conduct, or decorum. The word 'viḻuppam' refers to the highest distinction, dignity, or excellence that a human can attain. Because proper conduct is the source of this greatness, the poet argues that it must be preserved at all costs. By comparing its value to 'uyir' (life) and stating it should be guarded 'uyiriṉum' (even more than life), the verse highlights that living without character is worse than death.
